input.quote: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE PARTIES' LIABILITY FOR INDEMNIFICATION, OR LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, SPECIAL OR OTHER SIMILAR DAMAGES
input.rationale: Section 7 "Limitation of Liability" contains only a mutual exclusion of consequential, incidental, indirect, punitive and special damages (with indemnification and confidentiality carved out of that exclusion). No aggregate liability cap exists anywhere in the Agreement — searches for "aggregate liability", "shall not exceed" and "fees paid" return nothing, and the fees/revenue-share provision (Section 5), warranty (Section 9), indemnity (Sections 10–11) and general provisions carry no cap. Both parties' direct liability is therefore unlimited, which fails the fallback requirement of a mutual cap based on 12 months of fees. We target the fallback: one added sentence creating a mutual twelve-month fees cap with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap. We have not pursued the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor, data-protection/fraud/IP carve-outs or the payment-obligations exclusion, which can be noted as further asks.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual 12-month fees liability cap with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 7 excludes consequential damages but contains no aggregate liability cap, leaving both Parties' direct exposure unlimited. We added a mutual cap at twelve months' fees, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct sitting outside the cap.

ops.text: Except with respect to a Party's indemnification obligations, breach of confidentiality obligations, gross negligence or wilful misconduct, each Party's aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
